hypothesis: A mandatory target obligation must not PASS when the positive readback and counterevidence probe reuse the same evidence identity, because the owner acceptance contract requires independent evidence paths.
observed_gap: TargetObligation validates non-empty evidence refs but does not reject overlap between positive_evidence_refs and counterevidence_refs; status therefore maps PASS+CLEAR to PASS even when both paths cite one shared evidence identity.
discriminator: Construct one mandatory T1 obligation with PositiveReadback.PASS and CounterevidenceProbe.CLEAR using the same exact ref on both paths. Expected fail-closed result: non-PASS or admission rejection.
scope: review test/workflow only; no canonical source mutation
